arguments.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS transaction_count FROM transactions WHERE date >= '2019-01-01' AND date < '2019-02-01'
arguments.explanation: Counts all transactions dated in January 2019.
assumptions: 'January 2019' is 2019-01-01 through 2019-01-31, all transaction types and statuses included.
Every transaction row counts, whether or not it has a fraud label or an error.
